source: Computed from the hackathon data set (tx_junction_transactions.csv, tx_customers_junction.csv): Antti and every customer with a postal code starting 01 aged 30–39, monthly averages over Sep 2025–Aug 2026, as in scripts/build_peer_benchmark.py

figures.label: Income
figures.sentence: Income: yours is 3301.63 EUR a month; for people aged 30–39 in the Vantaa area it is typically 2695.05 EUR a month (middle half 2274.91 EUR a month to 3346.78 EUR a month).
figures.definition: salary and other income credited, a month (net, after tax)

figures.label: Housing as share of income
figures.sentence: Housing as share of income: yours is 32.5 %; for people aged 30–39 in the Vantaa area it is typically 33.0 % (middle half 27.6 % to 40.6 %).

figures.label: Kept of income
figures.sentence: Kept of income: yours is -0.4 %; for people aged 30–39 in the Vantaa area it is typically 7.1 % (middle half -0.2 % to 18.2 %).
figures.definition: (income − spending in all 10 categories) ÷ income; investing counts as kept

figures.label: Restaurants
figures.sentence: Restaurants: yours is 291.37 EUR a month; for people aged 30–39 in the Vantaa area it is typically 154.97 EUR a month (middle half 79.11 EUR a month to 238.75 EUR a month).

figures.label: Shopping
figures.sentence: Shopping: yours is 277.79 EUR a month; for people aged 30–39 in the Vantaa area it is typically 170.19 EUR a month (middle half 102.63 EUR a month to 247.72 EUR a month).

figures.label: Buffer
figures.sentence: Buffer: yours is 2.6 months; for people aged 30–39 in the Vantaa area it is typically 2.1 months (middle half 0.3 months to 5.0 months).
figures.definition: account balance on 2026-09-14 ÷ essentials a month (housing, utilities, groceries, transport)
